title: 第15章 杂役弟子第16章 剑势
slug: 顶级悟性从修炼基础剑法开始
lines: 第十五章杂役弟子
剑气直接轰在那只三阶寒阴地龙的身上，寒阴地龙在这道剑气之下，没有任何抵挡之力，瞬间被斩成两半。
青色的血液，直溅数丈远。
而此时场中也多了一道道白色身影，这一道道身影，闪烁间，剑气纷飞，那一只只寒阴地龙，也随之被不断斩杀。
仅仅几十个呼吸的时间，场中的寒阴地龙就被全部清理。
“多谢前辈救命之恩。”
方羽看着身前的老者，对着老者拱手致谢道。
老者听到方羽之言，也转过身来，看向了方羽。
看着方羽，老者仔细打量了一番，眉头微微一皱，随后一把握住方羽的手腕。
方羽只感觉一股力量，自手腕涌入，随后开始游走全身。
半晌之后，老者放开方羽的手。
“可惜。”
老者看着方羽，不由摇了摇头开口说道。
“弟子陆玄，见过徐长老。”
而此时陆玄也来到方羽的身侧，对着方羽身前那位老者拱手喊道。
“不必拘礼，如今你已经不是我剑阁弟子，不必向我行弟子礼。”
徐元看着陆玄淡淡的开口说道。
陆玄听到之后，也没有反驳，直起身来，看着徐元开口说道。
“好在徐老及时来援，不然我们今日怕是凶多吉少。”
徐元听到之后，看着陆玄和方羽淡淡的开口说道。
“这十万大山的矿坑，朝廷分配于我剑阁管辖，你们有难，我剑阁自然不可能置之不理，剑阁距离此处虽然不远，但也不近，你们能够坚持到我来，很不错。”
陆玄听到之后，不由看向方羽。
若不是方羽，今日怕是他们还真撑不到剑阁的支援。
“今日的一切，还要感谢方羽，若不是他帮我们拦住这只一阶寒阴地龙，怕是我们已经沦为寒阴地龙的腹中食了。”
陆玄看着方羽，以及方羽身后那只一阶寒阴地龙的尸体开口说道。
徐元听到之后，微微颔首，随后目光落在方羽的身上。
“青元石矿，乃是朝廷的战略资源，交由我剑阁管辖，若是有失，我剑阁必然有责任，你协助陆玄守护矿坑有功，说吧，有什么要求，我会尽量满足。”
徐元看着方羽开口说道。
周围众多矿奴和护卫，听到徐元之言，看向方羽，都不由面露羡慕之色。
就算是陆玄此时眼中都露出了些许艳羡之色。
不过想到，之前方羽拼死拦住那只一阶寒阴地龙，众人心中都无比的佩服。
方羽听到徐元之言，心中不由升起了希望。
心中不断盘算着，随后方羽抬起头看向徐元。
“请长老收我为徒。”
周围众多矿奴和护卫，听到方羽之言，都不由张大嘴巴，看着方羽。
content_en:
Chapter 15: Handyman Disciple
"Bang."
The sword energy directly hit the third-level Hanyin Earth Dragon. Under this sword energy, the Hanyin Earth Dragon had no resistance and was cut in half in an instant.
Cyan blood splashed several feet away.
At this time, white figures appeared in the field. As these figures flickered, sword energy flew, and the Hanyin Earth Dragons were continuously killed.
In just a few dozen breaths, all Hanyin Earth Dragons in the field were cleared.
"Thank you, senior, for saving your life."
Fang Yu looked at the old man in front of him and thanked him with his hands.
When the old man heard Fang Yu's words, he turned around and looked at Fang Yu.
Looking at Fang Yu, the old man looked at it carefully, frowned slightly, and then held Fang Yu's wrist.
Fang Yu only felt a surge of power pouring in from his wrist, and then began to spread throughout his body.
After a while, the old man let go of Fang Yu's hand.
"What a pity."
The old man looked at Fang Yu, shook his head and said.
"Disciple Lu Xuan, I have met Elder Xu."
At this time, Lu Xuan also came to Fang Yu's side and shouted to the old man in front of Fang Yu.
"There is no need to be polite. Now that you are no longer a disciple of my sword pavilion, there is no need to bow to me as a disciple."
Xu Yuan looked at Lu Xuan and said calmly.
After Lu Xuan heard this, he did not refute. He straightened up, looked at Xu Yuan and said.
"Fortunately, Mr. Xu came to help in time, otherwise we would have been in trouble today."
After Xu Yuan heard this, he looked at Lu Xuan and Fang Yu and said calmly.
"The imperial court assigned the mines of Shiwanda Mountain to my jurisdiction. If you are in trouble, I, of course, cannot ignore it. Although Jiange is not far from here, it is not close either. It is good that you can persist until I come."
After Lu Xuan heard this, he couldn't help but look at Fang Yu.
If it weren't for Fang Yu, they might not be able to support Jiange today.
"Thanks to Fang Yu for everything today. If he hadn't helped us stop this first-order Hanyin Earth Dragon, I'm afraid we would have fallen into the belly of the Hanyin Earth Dragon."
Lu Xuan looked at Fang Yu and the body of the first-order Hanyin earth dragon behind Fang Yu and said.
After hearing this, Xu Yuan nodded slightly, and then his eyes fell on Fang Yu.
"The Qingyuan Stone Mine is a strategic resource of the imperial court. It is under the jurisdiction of our Jiange. If there is any mistake, our Jiange will be responsible. You have done a good job in helping Lu Xuan protect the mine. Tell me, if you have any requests, I will try my best to meet them."
Xu Yuan looked at Fang Yu and said.
Many mine slaves and guards around him couldn't help but look envious when they heard Xu Yuan's words and looked at Fang Yu.
Even Lu Xuan had a hint of envy in his eyes at this time.
However, when they thought about Fang Yu's desperate efforts to stop the first-order Hanyin Earth Dragon, everyone was filled with admiration.
When Fang Yu heard Xu Yuan's words, he couldn't help but feel hope in his heart.
Fang Yu kept thinking in his mind, then raised his head and looked at Xu Yuan.
"Please, elder, accept me as your disciple."
When the many mining slaves and guards around him heard Fang Yu's words, they couldn't help but open their mouths and look at Fang Yu.
